title: Weighted approximate tangent at H^n-a.e. point of a continuity piece of a chart (proof of Simon Ch. 3, 1.6 'only if', and Remark 1.8(1))
statement: Let n >= 1, U an open subset of R^(n+l), and V = v(M, theta) a rectifiable n-varifold in U (contract structure RectifiableVarifold). Let C be a compact set contained in M with theta restricted to C continuous, N a Borel set with H^n(N) < infinity, and T a map from R^(n+l) to the linear subspaces of R^(n+l) such that for every x in N, T(x) is the approximate tangent space of N at x (SimonGMT HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N x (T x), Simon Ch. 3, Def. 1.4). Then for H^n-a.e. x in C cap N, T(x) is the approximate tangent space of M with respect to theta at x (SimonGMT HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M theta x (T x), Simon Ch. 3, Def. 1.7): dim T(x) = n and lim_{r -> 0+} int_{eta_{x,r}(M)} f(y) theta(x + r y) dH^n(y) = theta(x) int_{T(x)} f dH^n for every f in C_c(R^(n+l)).
lean_statement: ∀ {n ℓ : ℕ} {U : Set (Amb n ℓ)} (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (C N : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (T : Amb n ℓ → Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ)), 1 ≤ n → IsOpen U → IsCompact C → C ⊆ V.carrier → ContinuousOn V.mult C → MeasurableSet N → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) N < ⊤ → (∀ x ∈ N, Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N x (T x)) → ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).restrict (C ∩ N)), Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n V.carrier V.mult x (T x)
